name: Artistree Summer Camp
description_short: Musical theater day camp at the Artistree studio in Mamaroneck, in theme weeks for rising K to 3rd grade and 4th to 9th grade. Campers sing, act and dance all week and put on a short performance for families on Friday.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund less a $75 cancellation fee before June 1 for summer camp; no refunds after June 1.

sessions.name: Week 8: K-Pop Demon Hunters (rising K to 1st)
Week 9: Disney on Broadway (rising K to 1st)
Week 9: Disney Magic on Broadway (rising 2nd to 3rd)

notes: Only four August 2026 weeks for rising K to 3rd grade are still posted (9:30 am to 3 pm, $595 a week); earlier 2026 weeks and the 4th to 9th grade camps are no longer readable on the site. Campers bring a nut free snack, nut free lunch and water bottle. Summer Camp 2027 enrollment begins December 1, 2026. Preschool half day camp weeks have also been offered.
